canonical_task_name: Direct and coordinate organizational strategy and operations
acquire_scope: Obtain governing objectives, existing policies and budgets; financial, operating, sales, and performance reports; demand and customer information; candidate, workforce, employee-performance, and schedule data; supplier performance, inventory counts, goods-movement, and facility status; and stakeholder, regulatory, and sustainability requirements for the organization or operating unit.
interpret_scope: Analyze performance against goals and budgets, identify productivity, cost, service, and demand implications, and assess workforce needs, candidate or employee fit and performance, supplier and logistics conditions, facility needs, commercial conditions, and cross-functional constraints.
decide_scope: Set operating goals, policies, budgets, and priorities, and choose unit-level personnel selections, training, evaluation outcomes, work assignments, schedules, suppliers, logistics, pricing, credit, marketing, layouts, facility actions, sustainability actions, and corrective improvements.
act_scope: Direct and coordinate departments and operating processes; carry out unit-level personnel selections and training, communicate evaluations, and assign work and schedules; implement commercial, logistics, layout, facility, and sustainability actions; communicate expectations and results; and, in retail-management settings, perform needed customer-service, stocking, or display work as part of unit operations.
capability_rating_rationale: The selected frontier rows EVID-v07-OPS-001 through EVID-v07-OPS-004 use Claude Opus 5 in Andon Labs' Vending-Bench 2, a substantive but bounded retail-operations configuration that integrates supplier search, email, inventory, pricing, payments, customer requests, and year-long business control without a human operator. Its five-run mean final balance was $11,181.87 (plus or minus $2,094), but the evaluation reports material alignment and execution failures and supplies no stage-specific reliability rates or qualified-human comparator for the broader management scope. Each stage is therefore rated 2: the agent performs substantial occupational components, but the evidence does not establish a stage-complete result at acceptable performance and a human would need to materially validate or correct ordinary work. The vector is not evidence of general management across workforce, facilities, budgeting, policy, and sustainability variants. Selected stage evidence IDs: EVID-v07-OPS-001, EVID-v07-OPS-002, EVID-v07-OPS-003, EVID-v07-OPS-004.

canonical_task_name: Develop and direct marketing strategy and execution
acquire_scope: Obtain customer and audience needs, competitor activity, demand and market conditions, product and channel information, costs and prices, program performance, commercial objectives, and relevant legal, resource, and schedule constraints.
interpret_scope: Assess customer segments, demand drivers, competitive position, price and channel implications, product and packaging opportunities, promotional performance, and the reasons results differ from objectives.
decide_scope: Select target customers, positioning, pricing, product and packaging priorities, promotional approach, distribution channels, resource allocation, partner use, and adjustments to the marketing program.
act_scope: Develop, launch, and coordinate the marketing program; direct staff and partners; release promotional and channel activities; monitor results; and implement evidence-informed changes.
capability_rating_rationale: MARKETINGAGENT directly demonstrates substantial analysis, campaign generation, and tool use on two static datasets, but its 15-task harness does not establish acceptable strategic quality, live release, spending, monitoring, or adaptation. The stagewise frontier is therefore 2/2/2/2, supported by the four MARKETINGAGENT evidence records.

canonical_task_name: Keep facilities safe, compliant, functional, and fit for use
acquire_scope: Obtain facility-condition and utilization information, work orders, inspection and incident findings, safety and compliance requirements, space and installation needs, equipment and supply status, budgets, contracts, schedules, staff capacity, and user requirements.
interpret_scope: Assess facility readiness, hazards, noncompliance, maintenance and repair needs, capacity and space constraints, equipment reliability, cost and schedule implications, and priorities for continued organizational use.
decide_scope: Select maintenance, repair, renovation, construction, space, installation, safety, staffing, contracting, purchasing, scheduling, and escalation responses needed to keep facilities fit for use.
act_scope: Coordinate and administer facility operations, maintenance, repairs, renovations, installations, space changes, contracts, supplies, schedules, staff procedures, and records so facilities remain available, safe, compliant, and reliable.
capability_rating_rationale: Acquire 4: EVID-v07-CAN-11-3013-01-OFFICE_LOOP-ACQ; Interpret 4: EVID-v07-CAN-11-3013-01-OFFICE_LOOP-INT; Decide 4: EVID-v07-CAN-11-3013-01-OFFICE_LOOP-DEC; Act 4: EVID-v07-CAN-11-3013-01-OFFICE_LOOP-ACT. Stagewise frontier; systems may differ. Real-office autonomous HVAC control is a substantive bounded facilities-management case with measured energy and comfort outcomes. Full configurations, human roles, performance, and boundaries are in OccupationTask_CapabilityEvidence.

canonical_task_name: Administer licenses, permits, and eligibility determinations
acquire_scope: Obtain applications, identity and supporting records, interviews, tests, observations, payments, prior decisions, and the governing licensing, permit, passport, or eligibility standards and procedures.
interpret_scope: Evaluate whether the submission is complete, authentic, internally consistent, and supported by the facts, and determine how the applicant's evidence compares with the governing standards.
decide_scope: Determine eligibility, test or application disposition, credential type and conditions, required clarification or escalation, applicable fees, and the requirements and appeal information to communicate.
act_scope: Administer the examination or review, issue or deny the credential or eligibility determination, collect and record required fees, document the basis, and communicate the decision and procedural options.
capability_rating_rationale: The roof-code validator supports 2/4/4/1 for a bounded Florida permit-review configuration. Humans create and submit the application record, but the integrated system interprets drawings against the governing code and makes accurate pass/fail findings without routine case-by-case correction. It generates a report but does not issue or deny a credential, collect fees, or communicate an enforceable determination.

canonical_task_name: Monitor, investigate, and remediate regulatory compliance
acquire_scope: Obtain applicable requirements and policies, operational and facility records, complaints and reported issues, inspection observations, prior findings, corrective-action evidence, and information about regulatory changes.
interpret_scope: Assess conformity, verify relevant facts, identify violations or control failures, determine their severity and cause, and evaluate whether corrective actions adequately resolve the condition.
decide_scope: Determine the compliance finding, warning, remediation requirement, enforcement or audit escalation, responsible party, follow-up method, and whether the matter can be closed.
act_scope: Conduct the review or inspection, document and communicate findings, warn responsible parties, initiate or support corrective action, escalate violations when warranted, and monitor the condition through resolution.
capability_rating_rationale: FinGuard supports 2/3/3/1 for bounded monitoring of LLM financial interactions against Chinese financial regulations. It retrieves applicable rules, detects and explains noncompliance, and adapts strongly to unseen policies, but reported response performance still implies routine verification and the system does not investigate regulated entities, impose remediation, or monitor closure.

canonical_task_name: Administer recruitment, credentialing, and the employment relationship
acquire_scope: Obtain job and workforce requirements, candidate applications and profiles, credentials, screening information, employment records, policies, benefits information, employee cases, separation information, and applicable organizational and legal requirements.
interpret_scope: Compare qualifications, credentials, and employment facts with job requirements, policies, and governing requirements; identify fit, eligibility, missing or inconsistent information, compliance issues, and employee-relations implications.
decide_scope: Rank or select candidates; determine screening, interview, offer, hiring, onboarding, or credential-eligibility actions; and choose appropriate employment-administration or employee-relations responses within delegated authority.
act_scope: Source and communicate with candidates; administer selection, hiring, orientation, benefits, records, policy communication, employee matters, reporting, and separation activities.
capability_rating_rationale: The stagewise frontier is 4/4/4/4. EVID-v07-OPS-005 supports Acquire 4 for the prospectively defined, bounded endpoint of retrieving and ranking up to ten public professional profiles from a contextual U.S. sourcing query: Pearch.ai returned 398 profiles for 45 of 48 queries, averaged 8.8 results per query, and ranked first on expert-recruiter relevance judgments. The missing recall study prevents a claim that it finds the complete candidate universe, but it does not invalidate the study-defined top-k sourcing endpoint. EVID-v07-OPS-006 through EVID-v07-OPS-008 support Interpret, Decide, and the bounded Act endpoint of advancing applicants in the preregistered Ghana teacher-recruitment experiment. These ceilings do not cover final hiring, onboarding, benefits, employee relations, separation, records, or licensing eligibility. Selected evidence IDs: EVID-v07-OPS-005, EVID-v07-OPS-006, EVID-v07-OPS-007, EVID-v07-OPS-008.

canonical_task_name: Design, coordinate, and improve lifecycle logistics
acquire_scope: Obtain customer and product-support requirements, demand and delivery commitments, inventory and material status, supplier and subcontractor information, maintenance and technical-data needs, lifecycle plans, costs, schedules, and logistics performance measures.
interpret_scope: Assess resource and service gaps, dependencies, bottlenecks, supportability, supplier and maintenance risks, cost and schedule tradeoffs, design-change effects, and performance against lifecycle commitments.

act_scope: Coordinate materials, suppliers, subcontractors, delivery, maintenance, technical data, training resources, and project controls; implement logistics changes; and monitor and report lifecycle cost and service performance.
capability_rating_rationale: JD.com's SCPA supports 3/3/3/3 for enterprise supply-chain planning. It integrates demand, inventory, fulfillment, and planning data and is deployed at very large scale with reported accuracy, in-stock, and processing-time gains. Human strategic intent and incomplete disclosure of exception and approval rates prevent 4s; physical fulfillment is outside the demonstrated endpoint.

acquire_scope: Obtain the client's capital needs, financial condition, existing obligations and capitalization, transaction objectives and constraints, comparable and market information, prospective counterparties, professional inputs, and execution requirements.
interpret_scope: Assess financing capacity, valuation, transaction feasibility, market receptivity, restructuring and capitalization alternatives, risks, participant dependencies, and the implications of possible terms and offering prices.

canonical_task_name: Safeguard information systems and data
acquire_scope: In computer-network and data-processing environments, obtain system and data inventories, architectures, configurations, user and business access needs, planned changes, incidents, violations, and continuity requirements; monitor threat and virus reports and data-file use; and conduct or obtain security-control and data-processing test results.
interpret_scope: Analyze vulnerabilities, threats, access activity, violations, and control effectiveness to determine exposure, access appropriateness, safeguard and testing gaps, and emergency or continuity implications.
decide_scope: Prioritize risks and choose safeguards, access changes, protection updates, remediation, emergency measures, implementation sequencing, escalation, and user-awareness responses.
act_scope: Implement and update security and access controls, regulate access, coordinate security-plan and system changes with users and service providers, address procedural violations and communicate corrective procedures, document safeguards, tests, and emergency measures, and train users.
capability_rating_rationale: EVID-v07-CYB-001 through EVID-v07-CYB-004 use stage-specific frontier configurations from CyberGym-E2E for the bounded source-code vulnerability workflow. Acquire = 4 because the agents independently navigate the supplied repository and build/test environment and gather the context needed for analysis without routine substantive human help; missed vulnerabilities are failures of interpretation, not acquisition of the available inputs. Interpret = 2 because open-ended vulnerability discovery remains materially incomplete: even an uncapped Claude Opus 4.6 agent reached about 63% end-to-end success, so a human must still search for important missed vulnerabilities. Decide = 3 and Act = 3 because GPT-5.4 with Codex achieved 87.1% in the patch-only setting, demonstrating strong autonomous remediation selection, code modification, rebuilding, and testing, while remaining failures and shallow fixes justify a routine technical review and validation gate. These ratings apply to substantive repository-based vulnerability discovery and remediation, not every information-security activity such as live-network monitoring, identity administration, continuity planning, policy, or user training. Selected stage evidence IDs: EVID-v07-CYB-001, EVID-v07-CYB-002, EVID-v07-CYB-003, EVID-v07-CYB-004.

canonical_task_name: Operate, secure, restore, and improve networked systems
acquire_scope: Obtain computing requirements, asset and configuration inventories, network and server status, logs and alerts, access and security information, backup and recovery status, user incidents, performance measures, dependencies, licenses, vendor information, and available parts or resources.
interpret_scope: Assess availability, performance, capacity, compatibility, security exposure, configuration integrity, fault causes, user impact, backup sufficiency, and recovery or upgrade requirements across the networked environment.
decide_scope: Select architecture and configuration changes, access controls, patches and upgrades, troubleshooting and repair steps, backup or recovery actions, resource priorities, vendor actions, and the response to incidents or anticipated requirements.
act_scope: Configure, administer, monitor, secure, troubleshoot, repair, restore, document, and improve network, server, operating-system, communications, and related environments, and provide the required user and vendor coordination.
capability_rating_rationale: The exact OperAID Qwen3.5-35B-A3B tool configuration supports 4/4/4/4 for three bounded Kubernetes/Open5GS fault classes. It collected telemetry, diagnosed faults, chose and executed remediation, and verified recovery with 93.3% success across 900 experiments. The 6.7% failed runs are treated as rare exceptions; the score does not generalize to all network administration, architectures, security incidents, or physical work.

canonical_task_name: Plan, design, and oversee civil engineering projects
acquire_scope: Obtain project requirements, applicable technical and safety criteria, cost, resource, and schedule data, and construction, operation, and maintenance status; collect or retrieve maps and topographic, geologic, traffic, and environmental data through site surveys, soil or material tests, and inspections, including aerial or drone-supported observations.
interpret_scope: Analyze site, material, hydraulic, structural, transportation, and environmental conditions; calculate loads, grades, flows, and stresses; and assess feasibility, cost, risk, impact, progress, defects, safety, and design conformance.
decide_scope: Select design specifications, alignments, materials, systems, sustainable or remediation methods, risk controls, resource priorities, and construction, repair, modification, operation, or maintenance responses.
act_scope: Prepare and present designs, drawings, calculations, reports, estimates, and bid or project documents; establish survey controls; provide technical advice; direct construction, operation, maintenance, and implementation of civil, contaminated-site cleanup, or toxic-waste system solutions; and control conformance and safety through inspection findings and communicated corrections.
capability_rating_rationale: Acquire 2 is supported by EVID-v07-BB-CIV-ACQ: an autonomous quadruped gathers substantial site-inspection imagery, but engineers still supply the BIM model and inspection targets. Interpret 4 is supported by EVID-v07-BB-CIV-INT, which automatically converts UAV imagery into accurate activity-level bridge-pier progress. Decide 4 and Act 4 are supported by EVID-v07-BB-CIV-DEC and EVID-v07-BB-CIV-ACT: a coherent generative-AI system selects an optimized shear-wall structural scheme and produces the analysis model and design artifacts without a routine engineer gate in the evaluated cases. These are separate bounded configurations and do not establish one autonomous end-to-end civil-project system.

interpret_scope: Assess mechanical behavior, stresses and performance, feasibility, safety, manufacturability, cost, environmental effects, test results, failure causes, operating limitations, and lifecycle maintenance implications.

capability_rating_rationale: LLM-IDA supports 4/4/4/4 for the bounded digital mechanical-design cases. Human provision of a high-level design goal and reusable templates is permitted by v0.7 and does not constitute routine substantive completion of Acquire; the configuration independently retrieves and organizes the needed design knowledge, simulates and optimizes candidates, selects a result, and creates digital prototypes.

acquire_scope: Obtain specifications and standards, representative samples, production and process conditions, equipment status, test methods and instrument readings, prior quality results, reported deviations, and laboratory-readiness information.
