occupation_name: Environmental Scientists and Specialists, Including Health
canonical_task_name: Investigate and address environmental hazards and impacts
acquire_scope: Collect, monitor, or retrieve environmental samples, measurements, records, site and production data, accident and project information, land-use and resource conditions, scientific literature, stakeholder and program needs, study and model inputs, and relevant standards or environmental legislation as scientific and program context.
interpret_scope: Validate, analyze, model, and synthesize environmental data to identify sources, conditions, trends, causes, effects, project or production impacts, scientific significance, and prevention or resource-management implications.
decide_scope: Choose monitoring, investigation, research, and modeling methods; select prevention or control recommendations; and set technical-guidance, program, policy, land-use, resource-management, or lower-impact practice priorities.
act_scope: Prepare and deliver charts, reports, briefings, training, and technical guidance; advise and coordinate government, industry, public, or program stakeholders; supervise or train staff; and develop or implement prevention, abatement, resource-management, land-use, or lower-impact methods and programs.
capability_rating_rationale: Acquire 4 is supported by EVID-v07-BB-ENV1-ACQ, an autonomous underwater robot that senses water conditions and collects imagery during coastal surveys. Interpret 4 is supported by EVID-v07-BB-ENV1-INT, which identifies urban emission source location and intensity without case-by-case expert interpretation in the evaluated inversion. Decide 4 and Act 4 are supported by EVID-v07-BB-ENV1-DEC and EVID-v07-BB-ENV1-ACT: a reinforcement-learning agent selects and directly executes dissolved-oxygen and recirculation control on physical wastewater reactors. Each score is a bounded frontier configuration, not coverage of all environmental media, hazards, policy questions, or remediation methods.

occupation_name: Environmental Scientists and Specialists, Including Health
canonical_task_name: Evaluate and administer environmental compliance and permitting
acquire_scope: Obtain permit or license applications, plans and reports, site and process records, monitoring results, applicable standards and regulations, and prior orders or case materials, and collect field evidence by conducting audits, inspections, or violation investigations.
interpret_scope: Compare applications, technical evidence, and observed conditions with requirements to assess completeness, technical adequacy, compliance, and the nature, extent, significance, and regulatory implications of violations.
decide_scope: Determine permit or license disposition and necessary conditions or corrections, compliance findings, enforcement response, referral or prosecution advice, and follow-up priorities.
act_scope: Process selected permit or license dispositions and conditions, implement standards and required regulatory follow-up, record and communicate compliance or enforcement determinations to affected and internal or public audiences, prepare technical portions of regulatory and enforcement documents, and coordinate or train staff.
capability_rating_rationale: Acquire 2 is supported by EVID-v07-BB-ENV2-ACQ: PermitAI coding agents search and extract across supplied permitting records, while humans still assemble the authoritative project corpus and missing site evidence. Interpret 2 is supported by EVID-v07-BB-ENV2-INT, where the strongest model reached 81.15% answer correctness only with gold passages. Decide 2 is supported by EVID-v07-BB-ENV2-DEC, whose enforcement benchmark reports persistent failures on evidence chains, contradictions, multi-source integration, and procedural judgment. Act 3 is supported by EVID-v07-BB-ENV2-ACT: PermitAI produces complete draft environmental-impact-statement sections for expert review. The evidence does not establish autonomous permit disposition, enforcement, or public release.

canonical_task_name: Assess psychological needs and provide counseling or treatment
acquire_scope: Obtain the client's concerns and goals, psychological and medical history, symptoms and functioning, behavioral observations, test and interview results, risk information, prior treatment, progress evidence, and relevant collateral information.
interpret_scope: Assess psychological functioning, needs, risks, strengths, diagnosis or formulation, contributing factors, treatment response, and whether further evaluation, referral, or crisis intervention is warranted.
decide_scope: Select the assessment conclusion, counseling or treatment plan, intervention and goals, risk response, referral and care-coordination approach, and adjustments based on progress or changing needs.
act_scope: Administer and document assessment, counseling, treatment, guidance, and risk intervention; monitor progress; communicate with the client and relevant care participants; and coordinate or complete referrals.
capability_rating_rationale: Acquire 3: EVID-v07-CAN-19-3033-01-THERABOT-ACQ; Interpret 3: EVID-v07-CAN-19-3033-01-THERABOT-INT; Decide 3: EVID-v07-CAN-19-3033-01-THERABOT-DEC; Act 3: EVID-v07-CAN-19-3033-01-THERABOT-ACT. Stagewise frontier; systems may differ. Therabot delivered clinically effective treatment, but near-real-time monitoring of every message and recorded interventions constitute routine substantive human oversight in the evaluated configuration. Full configurations, human roles, performance, and boundaries are in OccupationTask_CapabilityEvidence.

canonical_task_name: Develop psychological services and practitioner capability
acquire_scope: Obtain population and institutional mental-health needs, existing program and service information, stakeholder requirements, practitioner skills and performance, supervision and training needs, available resources, and service or outreach outcomes.
interpret_scope: Assess service and access gaps, program effectiveness, workforce capability, organizational and community needs, implementation constraints, and the implications of professional or institutional consultation evidence.
decide_scope: Select service and program design, outreach and prevention priorities, supervision and training approach, consultation recommendations, resource use, implementation plan, and evaluation or improvement actions.
act_scope: Develop and implement psychological services, programs, outreach, and prevention activities; advise institutions and professionals; supervise or train practitioners; and document and evaluate the resulting capability.
capability_rating_rationale: The randomized LLM-simulated counseling-practice configuration supports 4/4/4/4 for the bounded practitioner-training episode. It independently captures the simulated dialogue, evaluates counseling behavior, selects structured feedback, and delivers practice and feedback without a routine human coach; 94 novice counselors showed improved client-centered skills. The rating does not cover designing or operating psychological-service programs, supervision across real cases, or clinical care.

canonical_task_name: Prepare forensic psychological evaluations
acquire_scope: Obtain the legal question and referral terms, relevant court and case records, psychological and medical history, interviews, behavioral observations, test results, collateral information, and applicable forensic evaluation standards.
interpret_scope: Assess psychological functioning and competence in relation to the legal question, reconcile the available evidence, identify limitations and alternative explanations, and determine the findings supported within psychological expertise.
decide_scope: Determine the forensic psychological conclusions, material qualifications, and the findings and reasoning that should form the court-directed opinion.
act_scope: Conduct and document the forensic evaluation and prepare and communicate a written psychological opinion suitable for use in the identified court proceeding.
capability_rating_rationale: Acquire IE; Interpret IE; Decide IE; Act IE. Stagewise frontier; systems may differ. No identifiable evaluated artifact was found that directly performs a forensic psychological evaluation, supports its legal conclusion, and reports performance and human intervention well enough to rate any stage. Full configurations, human roles, performance, and boundaries are in OccupationTask_CapabilityEvidence.

canonical_task_name: Conduct and report applied psychological research
acquire_scope: Obtain the applied clinical or counseling research question, prior knowledge, study population and data, candidate measures and methods, intervention or assessment information, study constraints, and relevant ethical and quality requirements.
interpret_scope: Analyze research data and observations, assess validity, uncertainty, limitations, and alternative explanations, and interpret what the results imply for psychological assessment, counseling, or intervention.
decide_scope: Select the research design, measures, methods, analysis, supported conclusions, reporting approach, and warranted directions for method or practice improvement.
act_scope: Design and conduct the applied study, collect and analyze its evidence, document the methods and limitations, and prepare and communicate the resulting psychological findings.
capability_rating_rationale: Acquire 2: EVID-v07-CAN-19-3033-04-AGENTSOCIETY-ACQ; Interpret 2: EVID-v07-CAN-19-3033-04-AGENTSOCIETY-INT; Decide 2: EVID-v07-CAN-19-3033-04-AGENTSOCIETY-DEC; Act 2: EVID-v07-CAN-19-3033-04-AGENTSOCIETY-ACT. Stagewise frontier; systems may differ. AgentSociety 2 executes substantial social-science research stages, while humans retain high-level theory, ethics, and research judgment. Full configurations, human roles, performance, and boundaries are in OccupationTask_CapabilityEvidence.

occupation_name: Educational, Guidance, and Career Counselors and Advisors
canonical_task_name: Assess and guide educational, career, and personal decisions
acquire_scope: Obtain the student's or client's abilities, interests, goals, records, tests, educational or employment history, personal circumstances, risks, barriers, program and service options, and relevant family, teacher, or institutional information.
interpret_scope: Assess strengths, needs, readiness, eligibility, fit with educational or career options, adjustment or behavioral concerns, crisis risk, service barriers, and progress toward the person's goals.
decide_scope: Select the guidance or support plan, educational and career options, counseling response, referral or crisis action, financial-aid or program recommendations, job-search support, and adjustments based on follow-up.
act_scope: Provide and document educational, career, personal, behavioral, or crisis counseling; teach relevant planning or job-search skills; connect the person with programs and services; make referrals; and follow progress.
capability_rating_rationale: The controlled career-counseling trial supports 2/2/2/2. Generative AI provides substantial information gathering, interpretation, recommendations, and counseling dialogue, but human counselors performed better on decision self-efficacy, time, and difficulty. The evidence does not establish independent crisis assessment, complete personal guidance, referrals, or longitudinal follow-up.

occupation_name: Educational, Guidance, and Career Counselors and Advisors
canonical_task_name: Design and coordinate student and career-support programs
acquire_scope: Obtain population and institutional needs, program objectives, participant and outcome information, policies and curriculum requirements, staff and resource capacity, employer and community opportunities, and stakeholder feedback.
interpret_scope: Assess service and transition gaps, participation and program effectiveness, recruitment and prevention needs, policy implications, resource constraints, and dependencies among educators, employers, staff, and community partners.
decide_scope: Select program goals, audience, curriculum and activities, orientation or recruitment approach, prevention and behavior policies, partnerships, staffing and supervision, schedule, resources, and evaluation or improvement plan.
act_scope: Design, promote, organize, deliver, and evaluate student-support and career programs; coordinate educators, employers, staff, and community partners; supervise program delivery; and document and improve results.
capability_rating_rationale: Targeted re-search found no Grade A-D artifact directly evaluating an identifiable AI configuration that designs and coordinates a student or career-support program under the frozen scope. Lesson-plan generation and tutoring systems are adjacent instructional artifacts, not evidence for institutional needs assessment, partnership and staffing decisions, program delivery, or evaluation. Every stage is IE rather than 0.

occupation_name: Mental Health and Substance Abuse Social Workers
canonical_task_name: Assess, treat, and coordinate recovery support for clients
acquire_scope: Obtain client history, symptoms, substance-use information, risks, functioning, goals, supports, observations, records, referrals, and prior treatment or service information.
interpret_scope: Assess client needs, mental and behavioral health status, risk, functioning, progress, treatment response, service barriers, and changes requiring attention.
decide_scope: Formulate or revise the assessment and treatment plan; select counseling approaches, recovery supports, referrals, safety responses, and matters requiring escalation or coordination.
act_scope: Provide counseling, education, crisis or recovery support; coordinate services and referrals; monitor follow-through; and document and communicate the client's course of care.
capability_rating_rationale: Acquire 3, Decide 3, and Act 3 are supported by EVID-v07-BB-MHSW1-ACQ, EVID-v07-BB-MHSW1-DEC, and EVID-v07-BB-MHSW1-ACT. Therabot elicited disclosures, selected psychotherapy responses, and delivered treatment in a randomized trial, but clinicians continuously monitored conversations and could intervene. EVID-v07-BB-MHSW1-INT supports Interpret 4 for a bounded text-only crisis-assessment configuration: a peer-reviewed fine-tuned Qwen2.5-1.5B model produced four final labels on 540 real hotline transcripts, with F1 scores of 0.805, 0.893, 0.753, and 0.886 for mood, ideation, plan, and high-risk status versus trained-operator scores of 0.729, 0.910, 0.772, and 0.897. The vector does not establish diagnosis, prospective crisis disposition, severe-crisis management, home investigation, benefits, housing, or multidisciplinary coordination. Selected evidence IDs: EVID-v07-BB-MHSW1-ACQ, EVID-v07-BB-MHSW1-INT, EVID-v07-BB-MHSW1-DEC, EVID-v07-BB-MHSW1-ACT.

occupation_name: Mental Health and Substance Abuse Social Workers
canonical_task_name: Develop community prevention, policy, and service programs
acquire_scope: Obtain community mental-health, substance-use, social, and service data; affected-group and stakeholder input; program performance and service-gap information; available resources; existing policy, program, and community conditions; and current knowledge through literature, social research, or professional training.
interpret_scope: Analyze prevalence, causes, risk and protective factors, service needs, coverage and access gaps, program performance, and policy or community-development implications to identify feasible intervention paths.
decide_scope: Select target populations and problems, prevention or service strategies, program design, resources and partnerships, policy recommendations, and community-development priorities.
act_scope: Develop and conduct prevention or service-improvement programs, prepare and communicate policy or community-development advice, educate and engage community members, coordinate partners, and document implementation and outcomes.
capability_rating_rationale: Acquire 2 and Interpret 2 are supported by EVID-v07-BB-MHSW2-ACQ and EVID-v07-BB-MHSW2-INT: an NLP/ML framework structures social-media interactions and predicts marijuana use among youth experiencing homelessness, but humans recruited participants, obtained consent and ground truth, and must integrate a modest AUC of 0.72. Decide 2 is supported by EVID-v07-BB-MHSW2-DEC, a preliminary AI aid that recommends intervention groups from social networks while human practitioners choose and run the program. Act 2 is supported by EVID-v07-BB-MHSW2-ACT: generative AI produced effective vaping-prevention ads, but youth focus groups and researchers refined and selected the final set. No source demonstrated autonomous community needs assessment, program authorization, deployment, and evaluation.

canonical_task_name: Lead worship, rites, and religious formation
acquire_scope: Obtain the relevant sacred texts, doctrines, laws, traditions, calendar and ceremonial requirements, community and participant needs, educational objectives, and participant or lay-leader readiness.
interpret_scope: Interpret the texts and traditions in relation to the occasion and community, assess doctrinal and formation needs, and determine the meaning, teaching, or preparation required for worship and religious practice.
decide_scope: Select the service or rite structure, sermon or teaching themes, readings and practices, educational approach, ceremonial details, and preparation required of participants and lay leaders.
act_scope: Prepare and lead worship, prayer, sermons, rites, and ceremonies; provide religious education and instruction; and prepare participants and lay leaders for authorized religious practice.
capability_rating_rationale: Acquire 1: EVID-v07-CAN-21-2011-01-FMG_BENCH-ACQ; Interpret 2: EVID-v07-CAN-21-2011-01-FMG_BENCH-INT; Decide 2: EVID-v07-CAN-21-2011-01-FMG_BENCH-DEC; Act 1: EVID-v07-CAN-21-2011-01-FMG_BENCH-ACT. Stagewise frontier; systems may differ. Models can retrieve and interpret doctrine and draft services or teaching, but clergy remain principal for authorized rites, embodied leadership, and formation. Full configurations, human roles, performance, and boundaries are in OccupationTask_CapabilityEvidence.

canonical_task_name: Provide pastoral and spiritual care
acquire_scope: Obtain the person or group's expressed concerns, spiritual and personal context, emotional and moral needs, crisis and safety information, relevant history, setting constraints, and available community or professional resources.
interpret_scope: Assess the nature, urgency, and spiritual or pastoral meaning of the need, identify risks and limits of pastoral support, and determine whether referral or continued care is appropriate.
decide_scope: Select the counseling, comfort, encouragement, visit, crisis response, referral, and follow-up approach responsive to the person, group, and setting.
act_scope: Provide pastoral counseling, comfort, encouragement, visits, and crisis support; connect people with appropriate services when needed; and continue or document follow-up care.
capability_rating_rationale: FMG-Bench supports 2/2/2/2 for bounded Christian pastoral-response scenarios. Guided language-model configurations produce useful context-sensitive assessment, escalation, advice, and response text, but the benchmark does not establish real-person outcomes, longitudinal care, referral completion, crisis reliability, or pastoral authority. Humans must materially validate and deliver care.

canonical_task_name: Lead congregational operations and community programs
acquire_scope: Obtain membership and community needs, program opportunities, committee and stakeholder input, budget and fundraising information, staff and volunteer capacity, facility and supply status, contracts, and lay-leader development needs.
interpret_scope: Assess organizational capacity, program and membership gaps, resource and facility constraints, financial implications, staffing and volunteer needs, and dependencies affecting the congregation's mission.
decide_scope: Select community and membership programs, committee and governance arrangements, budgets, fundraising, contracts, staffing and volunteer assignments, facility and supply priorities, and lay-leader development actions.
act_scope: Organize and coordinate congregational and community programs, committees, finances, fundraising, contracts, facilities, supplies, staff, volunteers, and lay-leader development so the organization is sustained.
capability_rating_rationale: The qualitative pastor-use study supports 1/1/1/1. ChatGPT-class tools contribute ideas, drafting, and administrative assistance, but the study provides no objective performance evidence and interviewed pastors retain needs assessment, organizational judgment, governance, resource allocation, relationship work, and execution.

canonical_task_name: Analyze legal issues and advise clients
acquire_scope: Obtain objectives, questions, facts, and documents from individual, business, or estate-representative clients in advisory matters; relevant statutes, regulations, rulings, precedents, and public records; transaction or liability context; third-party and specialist input; deadlines; and matter resources.
interpret_scope: Research and interpret legal authorities and facts, reconcile conflicting information, and assess rights, obligations, liability, risk, likely consequences, and available legal options.
decide_scope: Select a defensible legal position, advice, recommended course, and matter priorities, including whether pursuing or defending action is advisable and whether specialist input or additional supporting work is needed.
act_scope: Deliver oral or written legal advice and opinions, explain options, risks, rights, and obligations, document the analysis and recommendation, and coordinate or supervise supporting legal and administrative work.
capability_rating_rationale: The composite frontier uses directly evaluated legal-research, practical-reasoning, and human-plus-AI writing configurations. Lexis+ AI retrieved and synthesized authorities but answered only 65% of preregistered queries accurately and legal RAG products hallucinated in 17% to 33% of responses (EVID-v07-LAW-001 and EVID-v07-LAW-002). GPT-5.2 reached 69.67% overall on the expert-rubric PLawBench while retaining material fact, statute, and reasoning errors (EVID-v07-LAW-003). In a peer-reviewed randomized trial, Vincent AI materially improved the productivity of students preparing client communications and legal memoranda, but the people performed and submitted the final work (EVID-v07-LAW-004). Each stage is therefore 2: the tools perform substantial components, but a lawyer must materially verify, integrate, choose, and deliver the advice.

canonical_task_name: Develop and advocate cases in disputes and legal proceedings
acquire_scope: For civil, criminal, agency, appellate, or contested-probate matters, interview clients and witnesses and search or obtain records, exhibits, public records, opposing filings and evidence, procedural history, applicable authorities and rules, forum requirements, expert or specialist input, and settlement positions.
interpret_scope: Evaluate the credibility and sufficiency of facts and evidence, analyze governing authorities, and assess claims, defenses, probable outcomes, procedural posture, damages or exposure, opposing positions, and appellate issues.
decide_scope: Select case theory, claims or defenses, evidence and witness strategy, motions and arguments, jury approach, negotiation or settlement positions, filing or appeal choices, and proceeding priorities.
act_scope: Draft and file briefs, motions, case-related opinions, and appeals; negotiate settlements; present evidence and summarize cases; question witnesses; argue motions; confer with judges; select jurors; represent clients in courts or agencies; and document and coordinate case work.
capability_rating_rationale: EVID-v07-LAW-005 through EVID-v07-LAW-008 separate document/evidence work from case judgment and advocacy. Harvey Assistant extracted litigation-relevant information from supplied legal records at 75.1%, but complex multi-document extraction remained incomplete. PLawBench models consumed noisy case narratives, analyzed claims and defenses, selected litigation positions, and generated complaints or defenses, yet the strongest overall model scored 69.67% and the peer-reviewed error analysis found recurring missing facts, broken reasoning chains, wrong law, and procedural errors. A randomized trial found that o1-preview sharply increased productivity for complaint analysis, motions, and persuasive writing, but upper-level law students remained the authors of the final work. All four stages are 2 because a lawyer still materially completes the record, analysis, strategy, filing, negotiation, and advocacy endpoint. Selected stage evidence IDs: EVID-v07-LAW-005, EVID-v07-LAW-006, EVID-v07-LAW-007, EVID-v07-LAW-008.

canonical_task_name: Develop legislation and enforcement frameworks
acquire_scope: Obtain policy objectives, existing constitutional, statutory, and regulatory authorities, program evidence, information about affected populations and operations, enforcement experience, stakeholder input, implementation resources and constraints, and comparable laws or programs.
interpret_scope: Analyze governing authority, the policy problem, program effects, conflicts, gaps, ambiguities, implementation and enforcement consequences, and impacts on affected stakeholders.
decide_scope: Select program structure, legislative provisions, definitions and standards, allocation of authority and resources, enforcement mechanisms and procedures, and amendment or interpretive positions.
act_scope: Draft and revise legislation and government-program documents, produce and communicate documented legislative interpretations, draft and communicate enforcement procedures and guidance, and coordinate or supervise supporting legal work.
capability_rating_rationale: EVID-v07-LAW-009 through EVID-v07-LAW-012 use the European Commission's context-aware legal-verification proof of concept integrated into LEOS. It retrieved and ranked in-force definitions and references, checked time validity, detected regulatory-reporting components, completed incomplete references, and extracted structured RDF while a drafter worked on an EU legislative act. The official report expressly leaves the choice of definition to the user and displays extracted information for user verification; it supplies no quantitative accuracy or field-deployment evidence. The proof of concept therefore supports substantial partial performance at each stage, but not a complete stage with only a routine gate. The vector is limited to legislative-reference, definition, and reporting-requirement support and does not cover policy evidence, stakeholder impacts, resource allocation, enforcement design, or a complete bill. Selected stage evidence IDs: EVID-v07-LAW-009, EVID-v07-LAW-010, EVID-v07-LAW-011, EVID-v07-LAW-012.

canonical_task_name: Structure and administer legal transactions, instruments, estates, and fiduciary matters
acquire_scope: Locate and obtain client or party objectives; transaction, property, estate, beneficiary, and fiduciary facts; existing instruments and counterpart terms; and legal or public records bearing on ownership, rights, and obligations.
interpret_scope: Examine the facts, records, instruments, and proposed terms to establish ownership and identify rights, duties, succession or fiduciary consequences, conflicts, gaps, and issues in the contemplated arrangement.
decide_scope: Choose the transaction, estate, ownership, or fiduciary structure; drafting provisions; negotiation positions; allocations of rights and duties; and administration or probate steps.
act_scope: Draft, revise, and finalize legal instruments; negotiate contractual agreements; prepare ownership opinions; probate wills and represent or advise executors and administrators; establish and administer the arrangements; serve as agent, trustee, guardian, or executor; and document and communicate the resulting rights, obligations, and actions.
capability_rating_rationale: The stagewise frontier combines two independent contract-work benchmarks rather than extrapolating from general language-model ability. Harvey Assistant extracted supplied legal-document content at 75.1% and answered contract-style document questions at 94.8%, with raw outputs evaluated against law-firm criteria and no lawyer intervening during a run (EVID-v07-LAW-013 and EVID-v07-LAW-014); the latter supports Interpret 4 for the bounded single-document question-answering configuration. In a separate 450-output benchmark, Gemini 2.5 Pro produced contract first drafts with 73.3% reliability and AI systems surfaced material risk warnings, but the report assigns commercial judgment, checking, and finalization to lawyers (EVID-v07-LAW-015 and EVID-v07-LAW-016). Acquire, Decide, and Act are consequently 2. Estate, probate, ownership-opinion, negotiation, and fiduciary-administration variants were not directly demonstrated.

canonical_task_name: Conduct proceedings and issue binding judicial decisions
acquire_scope: Obtain the case record, pleadings and motions, governing law and procedure, evidence and testimony, party positions, prior rulings, jury and hearing information, and facts relevant to the requested judicial action.
interpret_scope: Assess jurisdiction and procedure, evidentiary relevance and credibility, disputed facts, legal standards, party arguments, available remedies, aggravating or mitigating circumstances, and the reasoning supported by the record.
decide_scope: Determine procedural and evidentiary rulings, findings, liability or responsibility, warrants and restrictions, remedies, custody or compensation, sentence, settlement treatment, and the content of the enforceable judgment or order.
act_scope: Conduct and control the proceeding, manage evidence, parties, juries, and courtroom process, issue oral or written rulings, orders, judgments, remedies, or sentences, and create the required judicial record.
capability_rating_rationale: Judge AI supports 2/4/4/4 for one bounded record-based international war-crimes appeal. Researchers compiled and converted the record, limiting Acquire to 2; GPT-4o then applied controlling precedent, resisted sympathy manipulation, selected affirm or reverse, and produced brief rulings across 100 runs without case-by-case human correction. The score does not extend to live proceedings, evidence admission, witness credibility, broad jurisdictions, or enforcement.

canonical_task_name: Prepare and coordinate legal matters under lawyer direction
acquire_scope: Obtain facts, client and witness information, governing law and legal sources, records and evidence, transaction or case requirements, deadlines, court and filing rules, attorney instructions, and the status of related documents and activities.
interpret_scope: Assess the relevance, completeness, consistency, and organization of facts, law, records, and evidence; identify procedural requirements, missing support, conflicts, and matters requiring attorney attention.
decide_scope: Select research paths, document and evidence organization, draft structure and supporting content, filing and coordination steps, scheduling priorities, and issues to elevate to the supervising legal team.
act_scope: Investigate and research the matter; gather, summarize, organize, and maintain records and evidence; prepare, edit, and file legal documents; coordinate clients, witnesses, professionals, courts, calendars, and case activities; and support proceedings under lawyer direction.
capability_rating_rationale: Relativity aiR supports 2/3/3/3 for a bounded 1,600-document litigation review. It reviews and codes documents with reported relevance recall of 83.9% and precision of 84.7%, and produces issue and review outputs, but mixed issue-coding performance and the need for lawyer validation prevent 4s. It does not independently run a complete legal matter.

occupation_name: Elementary School Teachers, Except Special Education
canonical_task_name: Teach and support elementary students
acquire_scope: In general elementary classrooms and school programs, obtain curriculum objectives and school requirements; observe individual and group student work, test results, behavior, social and physical development, safety, and access needs; and gather family, staff, assistant or volunteer, resource, and classroom information.
interpret_scope: Evaluate and grade student work, tests, progress, strengths, learning and behavioral needs, development, classroom conditions, and disability-access needs; evaluate assistant or volunteer performance and program effectiveness; and synthesize family and professional input relevant to instruction and support.
decide_scope: Choose and adapt learning objectives, lessons, materials, grouping, pacing, assessments, remediation, accommodations, behavior and safety responses, enrichment, staff or volunteer assignments, program revisions, resources, and coordination priorities.
act_scope: Prepare classrooms and materials; communicate objectives; deliver and adapt individual and group instruction, remediation, counseling, tests, projects, trips, and developmental activities; maintain order and safe equipment use; record grades and maintain or report student records; confer with families and professionals; develop or revise programs; supervise assistants and volunteers; select, order, and inventory supplies; and perform school-monitoring, committee, professional-development, and extracurricular duties.
capability_rating_rationale: EVID-v07-EDU-001 through EVID-v07-EDU-004 use Maths-Whizz as independently evaluated by NFER in a high-security randomized trial across 63 English primary schools and 8,983 pupils with final outcomes. In bounded Years 2-5 mathematics tutor sessions, the system administered adaptive assessment, diagnosed topic gaps and mathematical age, created and continually adjusted learning plans, and delivered questions, explanations, practice, tests, and feedback without a human tutor selecting or correcting each step. The trial found an effect size of 0.08, approximately one month of additional progress, and 0.14 for pupils eligible for free school meals. Teachers provided ordinary classroom teaching outside the product, facilitated access, and could constrain topics, so the 4/4/4/4 vector applies only to the substantive adaptive-math-tutoring configuration, not classroom management, safety, counseling, family conferences, trips, broad curriculum teaching, or school-program administration. Selected stage evidence IDs: EVID-v07-EDU-001, EVID-v07-EDU-002, EVID-v07-EDU-003, EVID-v07-EDU-004.

canonical_task_name: Provide patron access, reference, instruction, and programs
acquire_scope: Obtain the patron's question, access need, audience and use context, relevant collection and external-resource information, circulation and borrowing status, applicable policies, technology or equipment condition, and program or instruction requirements.
interpret_scope: Clarify the patron's intent, assess source relevance and suitability, identify access or retrieval barriers, determine the patron's information or technology skill needs, and evaluate whether the available resources satisfy the request.
decide_scope: Select search and retrieval approach, resources, borrowing or referral path, circulation response, explanation or instruction, technology troubleshooting, and the content and format of a program, bibliography, or display.
act_scope: Search, retrieve, circulate, borrow, and present information resources; explain policies and access; teach information, computer, or media skills; troubleshoot access equipment; and deliver patron programs, bibliographies, or displays.
capability_rating_rationale: Acquire 2: EVID-v07-CAN-25-4022-01-LIB_RAG-ACQ; Interpret 2: EVID-v07-CAN-25-4022-01-LIB_RAG-INT; Decide 2: EVID-v07-CAN-25-4022-01-LIB_RAG-DEC; Act 2: EVID-v07-CAN-25-4022-01-LIB_RAG-ACT. Stagewise frontier; systems may differ. A grounded chatbot completes bounded reference interactions, but small-sample performance does not establish reliable service across complex patron needs. Full configurations, human roles, performance, and boundaries are in OccupationTask_CapabilityEvidence.

canonical_task_name: Develop and maintain library collections and discovery systems
acquire_scope: Obtain collection goals and user needs, usage and circulation information, inventory and condition records, metadata and cataloging requirements, vendor and price information, course and institutional needs, budget constraints, and database, equipment, and system status.
interpret_scope: Assess relevance, demand, collection gaps and duplication, resource condition and obsolescence, classification and metadata needs, discoverability, vendor and cost implications, and the performance of supporting records, equipment, and systems.
decide_scope: Select resources to acquire, license, retain, discard, or preserve; determine classification, cataloging, metadata, vendor, inventory, and course-material actions; and choose changes to discovery aids and supporting technology.
act_scope: Order and license resources; classify and catalog them; update databases, inventories, access aids, and collection lists; retain, weed, or preserve materials; coordinate vendors and course materials; and maintain supporting equipment and systems.
capability_rating_rationale: The cataloging study supports 2/2/2/2. A generative-AI chatbot creates bibliographic descriptions, classifications, headings, and record text, but final DDC and LCC accuracy was only 26% and 20%, LCSH accuracy 54%, and human cataloger review remained essential. It does not establish collection-policy, acquisition, licensing, preservation, or full collection administration.

canonical_task_name: Direct library operations and services
acquire_scope: Obtain community and stakeholder needs, service and collection proposals, policies and governance requirements, budget and operational information, staffing and schedule capacity, facility and resource status, performance evidence, and institutional priorities.
interpret_scope: Assess service performance, operational and policy gaps, resource and budget constraints, staffing and training needs, stakeholder implications, and risks to reliable library or media-center operations.
decide_scope: Select policies and services, budgets and resource priorities, staffing and schedules, training and operating procedures, stakeholder and committee positions, and changes needed to improve library operations.
act_scope: Set and implement policies and services; plan and administer budgets and daily operations; hire, schedule, train, and direct staff; consult stakeholders; and represent the library in institutional and community governance.
capability_rating_rationale: Acquire IE; Interpret IE; Decide IE; Act IE. Stagewise frontier; systems may differ. The search found reviews and reported uses but no identifiable evaluated AI configuration with adequate performance and human-role evidence for library budgeting, staffing, policy, and operations. Full configurations, human roles, performance, and boundaries are in OccupationTask_CapabilityEvidence.

canonical_task_name: Coordinate curricula, teaching standards, and educator support
acquire_scope: Obtain curriculum and instructional needs, student and program performance, teaching observations, applicable standards, policies, and accreditation requirements, educator and administrator input, current materials and technology, available resources, and implementation results.
interpret_scope: Assess curriculum alignment and gaps, instructional and educator-performance needs, policy implications, material suitability, implementation quality, program effectiveness, and constraints affecting teaching improvement.
decide_scope: Select curriculum and program revisions, standards and policy guidance, educator coaching and training, instructional materials and resources, implementation approach, and evaluation and improvement priorities.
act_scope: Develop and coordinate curriculum and program changes, advise and train educators, organize instructional resources, communicate requirements and objectives, monitor implementation, and document and improve teaching support.
capability_rating_rationale: The lesson-plan assessment study supports 2/2/2/2. The LLM configuration generates and evaluates instructional-design artifacts with moderate agreement with trained raters, but it does not establish institution-wide standards alignment, teacher observation, coaching, implementation monitoring, or curriculum coordination. Human instructional leaders materially complete every frozen stage.

canonical_task_name: Design and evaluate instructional systems and learning products
acquire_scope: Obtain audience and performance needs, domain content and subject-matter input, existing courses and materials, learning and accreditation requirements, delivery and technology constraints, evaluation data, and cost and feasibility information.
interpret_scope: Assess learning and performance gaps, define the meaning and structure of content, evaluate instructional effectiveness and usability, and identify implications of audience differences, technology, standards, feasibility, and cost.
decide_scope: Select learning objectives, instructional strategy and sequence, delivery mode and technology, content and activities, assessment and measurement approach, documentation, and revisions needed to meet the defined learning outcome.
act_scope: Research, design, edit, produce, and document courses, courseware, assessments, and instructional aids; present design recommendations; evaluate usability and effectiveness; and revise the learning product.
capability_rating_rationale: The 16-week GPT-4o adaptive-curriculum configuration supports 4/4/4/4 for a bounded course-level instructional system. It continuously collected learner data, maintained profiles, chose content, difficulty, pacing, and format, and delivered adaptations through the LMS; a randomized 270-student study reported large learning and engagement gains. The boundary is one Thai course and does not establish institution-wide adoption or all subjects.

canonical_task_name: Deliver visual communication designs and production-ready content
acquire_scope: Gather the client or supervisor brief, communication purpose, audience research, source content, images and presentation references, prior assets, candidate software or design concepts, production specifications, and review feedback.
interpret_scope: Synthesize the purpose, audience, content, references, and feedback; evaluate the visual relationships among illustrative material and copy, design coherence, final-layout issues, and production constraints or readiness.
decide_scope: Select concepts, media, layout, typography, color, imagery, illustration, designer-supplied copy or content, production methods, and revisions that best serve the communication purpose.
act_scope: Create and revise concepts, rough sketches, layouts, graphics, charts, images, illustrations, still or animated broadcast graphics, and design-integrated copy or content; present layouts and produce photographs or proofs of them; incorporate feedback; assemble and mark up final layouts; prepare production files and worker instructions; and archive and deliver the result for print, web, or broadcast use.
capability_rating_rationale: The design frontier is stage-specific. PosterAgent automatically distilled a supplied paper into text-and-visual assets, but did not obtain a client brief, audience research, specifications, or feedback (EVID-v07-DES-001). A 19-model graphic-design benchmark found GPT-4.1 strongest overall at only 65.5%, and Graphist generated strong but explicitly draft-level element layouts rather than the broader concept and production plan (EVID-v07-DES-002 and EVID-v07-DES-003), supporting 2 for Interpret and Decide. A peer-reviewed Stable Diffusion/CLIP/ControlNet framework generated complete static designs across five commercial scenarios with no manual post-processing in the core test and over 91% cycle-time savings, while its practical workflow retained human refinement and verification and 80% of outputs needed minor adjustment (EVID-v07-DES-004). Act is therefore 3, not 4; source-file export, dynamic design, nuanced brand judgment, and final production handoff remain material limits.

canonical_task_name: Investigate, verify, and report news
acquire_scope: Obtain leads and potential subjects, source and public records, interviews and observations, background information, images, video, audio, location information, publication requirements, and new or changing evidence relevant to the account.
interpret_scope: Assess newsworthiness, source credibility and independence, factual consistency, corroboration, context, material gaps, visual and audio meaning, and the significance of the evidence for the intended audience.
decide_scope: Select the subject, angle and emphasis, sources and facts to include, additional verification, narrative and visual organization, medium, timing, and the treatment of uncertainty or correction.
act_scope: Investigate, interview, observe, verify, write, edit, record, photograph, present, transmit, and publish or broadcast the coherent news account through the required medium.
capability_rating_rationale: Robo-Reporters supports 3/3/3/3 for bounded digital reporting tasks. Across 200 controlled experiments and 50 graduated journalism tasks, the strongest multi-agent architecture searched sources, rejected weak evidence, made editorial choices, and produced story artifacts with 84.7% accuracy. That performance still requires routine editorial verification and does not establish interviews, field reporting, legal review, or publication across breaking-news conditions.

canonical_task_name: Develop and present news analysis, commentary, or criticism
acquire_scope: Obtain the news event, public subject, artistic or sports work, background and contextual evidence, relevant arguments and prior commentary, audience context, and requirements of the column, review, blog, script, or broadcast format.
interpret_scope: Analyze the subject's meaning, significance, quality, implications, evidence, arguments, and context, distinguish supported interpretation from factual uncertainty, and identify the central analytical or critical contribution.
decide_scope: Select the thesis or interpretive position, supporting evidence and examples, emphasis, tone, organization, degree of judgment, and the most suitable commentary or criticism format.
act_scope: Write, edit, record, or present the analysis, interpretation, commentary, or critique and deliver it to the intended public audience through the assigned medium.
capability_rating_rationale: Deep-research agents support substantial but incomplete source acquisition and synthesis, while the financial-commentary experiment directly establishes AI-authored commentary but does not disclose the exact model, factual-accuracy performance, source grounding, or human preparation. The resulting stagewise frontier is 2/2/2/2.

canonical_task_name: Create and prepare written work for a defined purpose and audience
acquire_scope: Obtain the purpose, intended audience, assignment or creative objective, subject information and research sources, format and publication requirements, client or collaborator input, rights constraints, and feedback on drafts.
interpret_scope: Assess the subject matter, factual and creative material, audience expectations, intended meaning, tone and voice, structural possibilities, source reliability, and how feedback affects the work.
decide_scope: Select the concept, argument or narrative, content and evidence, voice and tone, organization, format, revisions, and publication or production preparation needed for the defined purpose and audience.
act_scope: Research or generate content, plan, draft, revise, edit, and proof the written work; resolve collaborator or client revisions and applicable rights requirements; and prepare the finished work for publication or production.
capability_rating_rationale: Acquire 2: EVID-v07-CAN-27-3043-01-DEEPRESEARCH-ACQ; Interpret 2: EVID-v07-CAN-27-3043-01-DEEPRESEARCH-INT; Decide 4: EVID-v07-CAN-27-3043-01-WRITING_RCT-DEC; Act 4: EVID-v07-CAN-27-3043-01-WRITING_RCT-ACT. Stagewise frontier; systems may differ. Research agents provide substantial source work, and GPT-5 independently produces effective finished texts in bounded propositional and creative tasks. Full configurations, human roles, performance, and boundaries are in OccupationTask_CapabilityEvidence.

canonical_task_name: Shape source footage and sound into a finished audiovisual production
acquire_scope: Obtain raw footage, sound, graphics, scripts and production requirements, technical specifications, available effects and titles, continuity information, and feedback from directors, producers, or other production collaborators.
interpret_scope: Assess the content and quality of source material, performance and story meaning, continuity, pacing, sound and image relationships, technical accuracy, missing material, and the effect of proposed revisions.
decide_scope: Select shots and sound, sequence and timing, transitions, titles, graphics and effects, continuity treatment, technical corrections, and revisions that create the intended coherent audiovisual work.
act_scope: Assemble and edit images and sound, synchronize and time sequences, integrate titles, graphics, and effects, perform continuity and technical checks, screen the result, and revise and prepare the finished production for its intended delivery or distribution.
capability_rating_rationale: Acquire 2: EVID-v07-CAN-27-4032-01-VIDEOAGENT-ACQ; Interpret 4: EVID-v07-CAN-27-4032-01-EDITDUET-INT; Decide 4: EVID-v07-CAN-27-4032-01-EDITDUET-DEC; Act 4: EVID-v07-CAN-27-4032-01-EDITDUET-ACT. Stagewise frontier; systems may differ. Video agents gather and orchestrate media substantially, while EditDuet directly completes analysis, editing decisions, and non-linear editing in bounded evaluated cases. Full configurations, human roles, performance, and boundaries are in OccupationTask_CapabilityEvidence.

canonical_task_name: Assess and provide comprehensive oral health care
acquire_scope: Obtain the patient's concerns and goals, dental and medical history, medications and risk factors, oral examination findings, images and test results, pain and functional information, prior care, and continuing-care needs.
interpret_scope: Assess oral condition, disease, injury, pain, function, diagnostic findings, treatment indications and contraindications, prognosis, medication and procedural risks, and the need for prevention, restoration, device work, or referral.
decide_scope: Select the diagnosis and course of care, procedures and sequence, restorative or prosthetic approach, materials and devices, pain and medication plan, preventive and counseling response, referral, and follow-up.
act_scope: Examine and diagnose the patient; provide preventive, restorative, endodontic, periodontal, surgical, prosthodontic, medication, and pain care; fit or provide devices; counsel the patient; and document and continue the care plan.
capability_rating_rationale: Stagewise evidence supports 2/3/3/4. Diagnocat materially interprets panoramic radiographs but does not collect the full history or physical examination. Perceptive's semi-automated restorative robot digitally planned crown preparation under dentist approval and completed the physical tooth preparation in six patients with no adverse events and strong precision. Routine plan approval prevents Interpret and Decide 4, while Act 4 is limited to the bounded autonomous crown-preparation endpoint.

canonical_task_name: Plan and maintain population oral-health programs
acquire_scope: Obtain population oral-health needs and risk information, service and access gaps, existing programs and outcomes, community and stakeholder priorities, available resources, policy constraints, and educational-resource needs.
interpret_scope: Assess the distribution and significance of oral-health needs, program and service gaps, barriers to prevention or care, the effectiveness of existing efforts, and priorities for a defined population.
decide_scope: Select program objectives and target groups, preventive or service activities, educational content and resources, organizational approach, partnerships, allocation of resources, and evaluation and maintenance plan.
act_scope: Develop, organize, implement, and maintain the population oral-health program and educational resources; coordinate participating organizations and services; and monitor and improve program delivery.
capability_rating_rationale: The population oral-health risk model supports 1/2/2/1. It consumes human-collected BRFSS and NHANES survey data and provides meaningful population risk prediction and prioritization, but transfer performance and calibration limitations require human interpretation. It does not design, organize, implement, or maintain a complete oral-health program.

canonical_task_name: Ensure safe and effective medication use
acquire_scope: Obtain medication orders, patient conditions and medication history, allergies and laboratory information, product identity and quality, formulary and coverage information, available inventory, applicable medication requirements, and evidence of response, adherence, or adverse effects.
interpret_scope: Assess order completeness and authenticity, medication appropriateness, dose, interactions, contraindications, duplication, product quality, preparation requirements, adherence and response, supply issues, and the implications for safe and effective use.
decide_scope: Determine whether and how to fulfill, clarify, adapt, substitute, compound, withhold, or escalate the medication order; select counseling and monitoring needs, supply actions, and practice-linked instruction for interns.
act_scope: Prepare, compound, verify, dispense, and document medications; counsel patients and clinicians; communicate and resolve medication issues; maintain required records and supplies; monitor medication use; and provide embedded intern instruction.
capability_rating_rationale: Acquire 2: EVID-v07-CAN-29-1051-01-PHARM_API-ACQ; Interpret 4: EVID-v07-CAN-29-1051-01-PHARM_API-INT; Decide 4: EVID-v07-CAN-29-1051-01-PHARM_API-DEC; Act 2: EVID-v07-CAN-29-1051-01-PHARM_ROBOT-ACT. Stagewise frontier; systems may differ. A high-agreement polypharmacy system supports interpretation and recommendation ceilings; physical dispensing remains only partially automated at the reported reliability. Full configurations, human roles, performance, and boundaries are in OccupationTask_CapabilityEvidence.

canonical_task_name: Assess and deliver rehabilitative physical therapy care
acquire_scope: Obtain the patient's history, goals, movement and functional findings, pain and other symptoms, physical measures, risks and precautions, relevant records, consent information, device and environment needs, and evidence of progress or treatment response.
interpret_scope: Assess impairments, movement and functional limitations, rehabilitation potential, pain and safety risks, response to interventions, barriers to goals, and the need for plan adjustment, referral, discharge, or practice improvement.
decide_scope: Select rehabilitation goals and plan, interventions and dosage, manual or equipment-based methods, devices, education and prevention approach, care coordination, progression or modification, referral, and discharge or follow-up.
act_scope: Evaluate and treat the patient through exercise, movement, manual, device-based, and other authorized interventions; educate patients, caregivers, and learners; coordinate and document care; apply relevant practice evidence; and discharge, refer, or follow up.
capability_rating_rationale: The SWORD digital biofeedback system supports 2/2/2/3 in a bounded eight-week post-hip-arthroplasty program. It captures and interprets exercise performance and helps implement a prescribed plan, but clinicians assess, prescribe, edit, and remotely monitor care. It delivers the exercise and feedback stage with strong outcomes, yet routine clinical contacts and caregiver assistance prevent Act 4.

canonical_task_name: Provide and sustain nursing care and health improvement
acquire_scope: Across patient-care, community, school, workplace, transport, and disaster-triage settings, obtain patient, family, group, or community histories and concerns; collect symptoms, vital signs, physical findings, diagnostic or laboratory results, treatment and anesthesia responses, and home or work-environment observations; and gather staffing, supply, program, and infection-control information.
interpret_scope: Assess patient or population conditions, needs, and risks; interpret and evaluate diagnostic findings; form tentative diagnoses where included; evaluate treatment responses and care quality; and synthesize community-health, staffing, resource, program, and infection-control implications.
decide_scope: Prioritize and choose or adapt care plans, diagnostic and treatment responses, drugs, devices, anesthetics, education, referrals, community-health programs, staffing and budget plans, training, resources, and infection-control actions.
act_scope: Perform physical examinations and specified tests; order diagnostic tests and communicate prescriptions or treatment recommendations; prepare patients and care environments; provide routine, specialized, emergency, triage, rehabilitation, anesthesia, and perianesthesia care; administer treatments, medications, anesthetics, first aid, and immunizations; educate and refer recipients; coordinate care; direct and train personnel; manage nursing units, resources, and community-health or infection-control programs; consult with institutions; and document care, decisions, and outcomes.
capability_rating_rationale: Acquire 4, Decide 4, and Act 4 are supported by EVID-v07-BB-RN-ACQ, EVID-v07-BB-RN-DEC, and EVID-v07-BB-RN-ACT. In a multicenter randomized crossover trial, AIDANET continuously acquired glucose, selected insulin dosing, and delivered it at home without meal announcements, improving mean sensor glucose from 178 to 164 mg/dL while maintaining noninferior hypoglycemia time. Interpret 4 is supported separately by EVID-v07-BB-RN-INT: the CONCERN model continuously interpreted nursing-documentation patterns into final deterioration-risk categories across 60,893 encounters, with lower mortality, sepsis, and length of stay. These narrow diabetes and inpatient-surveillance configurations do not cover the task's broader bedside, community, staffing, program, or infection-control variants.

canonical_task_name: Provide comprehensive longitudinal primary medical care
acquire_scope: Obtain the patient's concerns and goals, history, symptoms, examination findings, medications, allergies and risks, tests and prior records, preventive status, preferences, social context, and evidence of response over time.
interpret_scope: Assess the patient's condition, differential diagnosis, severity and urgency, risk factors, test meaning, treatment response, preventive needs, uncertainty, and need for specialist or other-provider involvement.
decide_scope: Determine diagnoses and clinical priorities, tests and monitoring, preventive and therapeutic plan, medications and procedures, counseling, referrals, coordination, follow-up interval, and adjustments across the course of care.
act_scope: Examine and monitor the patient; order or perform appropriate tests and care; prescribe and deliver preventive or therapeutic treatment; vaccinate and counsel; document the plan and response; and coordinate referrals and other providers.
capability_rating_rationale: Acquire 4: EVID-v07-CAN-29-1215-01-DOCTRONIC-ACQ; Interpret 4: EVID-v07-CAN-29-1215-01-DOCTRONIC-INT; Decide 4: EVID-v07-CAN-29-1215-01-DOCTRONIC-DEC; Act 2: EVID-v07-CAN-29-1215-01-PREA-ACT. Stagewise frontier; systems may differ. Doctronic supports a bounded autonomous virtual urgent-care ceiling through treatment planning; physical examination, prescribing, procedures, and longitudinal care remain human. Full configurations, human roles, performance, and boundaries are in OccupationTask_CapabilityEvidence.

canonical_task_name: Evaluate patients through diagnostic imaging and communicate findings
acquire_scope: Obtain the clinical question, patient history, current and prior examinations, acquisition details, image-quality information, and other case context needed across the diagnostic modalities in scope.
interpret_scope: Assess whether images are diagnostically adequate and relate them to the history, clinical question, and prior studies to identify findings, limitations, and an image-based diagnosis.
decide_scope: Select or approve any additional techniques, positions, projections, or examinations needed; determine the final assessment, urgency, follow-up, and necessary clinical coordination or communication.
act_scope: Complete or direct the diagnostically adequate examination, finalize the interpretive report, and communicate or coordinate the result with the clinicians, patients, or families who use it.
capability_rating_rationale: Acquire 4: EVID-v06-RAD-01-ULTRABOT-ACQ; Interpret 4: EVID-v06-RAD-01-CHESTLINK-INT; Decide 4: EVID-v06-RAD-01-CHESTLINK-DEC; Act 4: EVID-v06-RAD-01-CHESTLINK-ACT. Stagewise frontier; systems may differ. Full configurations, performance, and boundaries are in OccupationTask_CapabilityEvidence.

canonical_task_name: Plan and perform image-guided procedures and manage procedural care
acquire_scope: Obtain the procedure request, patient history and consent-related information, relevant imaging and tests, planned target, medications and risk factors, equipment status, and live peri-procedural patient observations.
interpret_scope: Assess the indication, anatomy, access path, treatment target, patient readiness, procedural risks, live image guidance, physiologic changes, complications, and the procedure’s result.
decide_scope: Choose the treatment plan, procedural approach, equipment and materials, sequence and maneuvers, safety precautions, and whether to proceed, modify, pause, stop, treat a complication, or escalate.
act_scope: Explain the process, risks, benefits, and alternatives; perform the image-guided diagnostic or therapeutic procedure; manage peri-procedural safety and complications; and document the procedure and outcome.
capability_rating_rationale: Acquire 2: EVID-v06-RAD-02-KUNTZ-ACQ; Interpret 2: EVID-v06-RAD-02-KUNTZ-INT; Decide 2: EVID-v06-RAD-02-KUNTZ-DEC; Act 2: EVID-v06-RAD-02-KUNTZ-ACT. Stagewise frontier; systems may differ. Full configurations, performance, and boundaries are in OccupationTask_CapabilityEvidence.

canonical_task_name: Plan and deliver nuclear medicine diagnosis or therapy
acquire_scope: Obtain the procedure request, patient history, clinical indication, relevant studies and tests, radionuclide options and availability, patient-specific dose inputs, instrument checks and readings, material-handling conditions, and patient status.
interpret_scope: Assess appropriateness relative to alternatives; determine diagnostic or therapeutic requirements, dose and technical implications, radioactive-material and instrument readiness, risks, and expected limitations.
decide_scope: Select the nuclear medicine application, radionuclide, dosage, technique, positions and projections, technical directions, and any adjustment, delay, cancellation, or escalation.
act_scope: Prescribe, calculate, measure, and prepare the selected dosage; verify material and dosage-instrument readiness; direct technical execution; administer the radioisotope; and advise clinicians about indications, assessments, risks, and limitations.
capability_rating_rationale: Acquire 0: EVID-v06-RAD-03-GEORGIOU-ACQ; Interpret 2: EVID-v06-RAD-03-SIMPLEDOSE-INT; Decide 2: EVID-v06-RAD-03-POPOVIC-DEC; Act 1: EVID-v06-RAD-03-GEORGIOU-ACT. Stagewise frontier; systems may differ. Full configurations, performance, and boundaries are in OccupationTask_CapabilityEvidence.

canonical_task_name: Provide end-to-end prehospital emergency response
acquire_scope: At a prehospital scene and during ambulance transport, receive dispatch, responder, and treatment information; observe scene and transport conditions; obtain patient history and monitor illness or injury signs, vital signs, heart activity, condition changes, and reactions; and inspect vehicle, communication and medical equipment, and supply readiness.
interpret_scope: Determine the nature and extent of illness or injury, changes in condition, responses to care, responder or receiving-facility needs, and infectious-disease decontamination or unit-readiness implications.
decide_scope: Prioritize medical procedures and choose stabilization, monitoring, reassurance, immobilization, movement, transport, coordination, handoff, decontamination, maintenance, and replenishment responses for the episode.
act_scope: Travel to the scene and drive when required; provide first aid, life support, airway management, stomach suction, and other emergency treatment procedures; reassure, immobilize, move, and transport the patient; coordinate with responders and receiving personnel and arrange reception; record, report, and hand off care, including infectious-disease case reporting; and decontaminate, maintain, and replenish the response unit.
capability_rating_rationale: Acquire 2 is supported by EVID-v07-BB-EMT-ACQ: CONNECT-AI automatically captures ambulance video, audio, vital signs, and hospital-resource data, while EMTs still obtain history, symptoms, mental status, and intervention details. Interpret 4 is supported by EVID-v07-BB-EMT-INT, a real-time trauma-mortality model externally validated across Korean and Australian centers with AUROCs of 0.895 to 0.956. Decide 2 is supported by EVID-v07-BB-EMT-DEC because CONNECT-AI ranks hospitals and suggests first-aid protocols but providers choose care and transport. Act 3 is supported by EVID-v07-BB-EMT-ACT: an autonomous-flight AED drone completed real emergency deliveries, but a remote pilot routinely performed checks, obtained clearance, and approved the drop. No evidence establishes autonomous hands-on EMT treatment or transport.

canonical_task_name: Provide coordinated in-home health and daily-living support
acquire_scope: Obtain the care plan and delegated instructions, client preferences, current condition and vital or behavioral observations, medication and activity schedules, environmental information, and reports from the client, family, or care team.
interpret_scope: Relate observations and client needs to the care plan; recognize health, functional, behavioral, environmental, or safety changes; and identify needs that exceed the aide's role or require reporting.
decide_scope: Prioritize and select permitted personal-care, daily-living, household, mobility, nutrition, companionship, and delegated health-support actions, including when and to whom a change must be reported or escalated.
act_scope: Provide hands-on personal and daily-living assistance, meals and household support, mobility and companionship, permitted medication or treatment assistance, monitoring, documentation, and reporting to the care team.
capability_rating_rationale: EVID-v07-BB-HHA-ACQ, EVID-v07-BB-HHA-INT, and EVID-v07-BB-HHA-DEC show substantial automated home sensing, anomaly classification, and alert selection, but the smart-home paper does not provide a reproducible field protocol, adequate reference standards, complete input-coverage evidence, or an accepted operational threshold; its field table reports fall recall of 89.5% and health-anomaly recall of 88.7%, while a later unreconciled confusion matrix implies 98.9% fall recall. Caregivers and participants materially supply context, feedback, thresholds, verification, and the response. EVID-v07-BB-HHA-ACT shows that the Section 7 UR5 + SPANet + Kiri-Spoon configuration autonomously detects and acquires selected foods, but participants routinely use a joystick for the final safe transfer to the mouth and no aggregate end-to-end success rate is reported. Each stage is therefore 2 rather than 3 or 4. Selected evidence IDs: EVID-v07-BB-HHA-ACQ, EVID-v07-BB-HHA-INT, EVID-v07-BB-HHA-DEC, EVID-v07-BB-HHA-ACT.

canonical_task_name: Provide and monitor basic daily patient care
acquire_scope: Obtain delegated care assignments, the patient's current condition and expressed needs, vital and routine measurements, mobility and daily-living status, safety risks, treatment and transport requirements, supplies, and immediate environmental conditions.
interpret_scope: Assess changes from the patient's usual condition, comfort and daily-care needs, mobility and fall risk, tolerance of activity or delegated treatment, urgency, and what information licensed staff need to receive.
decide_scope: Select the sequence and method of delegated basic care, positioning and mobility assistance, comfort and safety response, supply and environmental actions, and when to pause, report, or seek licensed clinical direction.
act_scope: Assist with eating, hygiene, toileting, positioning, mobility, comfort, routine delegated treatments, procedures, and transport; measure and record observations; maintain supplies and the immediate environment; and communicate material changes to licensed staff.
capability_rating_rationale: Acquire 2: EVID-v07-CAN-31-1131-01-NURSE_ROBOT-ACQ; Interpret 1: EVID-v07-CAN-31-1131-01-NURSE_ROBOT-INT; Decide 1: EVID-v07-CAN-31-1131-01-NURSE_ROBOT-DEC; Act 2: EVID-v07-CAN-31-1131-01-NURSE_ROBOT-ACT. Stagewise frontier; systems may differ. Hospital robots materially collect selected observations and perform deliveries, while nursing assistants retain principal interpretation, decisions, and hands-on personal care. Full configurations, human roles, performance, and boundaries are in OccupationTask_CapabilityEvidence.

canonical_task_name: Coordinate ambulatory appointments and front-office services
acquire_scope: Obtain patient identity and contact information, service and appointment requests, provider and schedule availability, referral and insurance information, required forms and correspondence, payment or billing details, and the status of administrative records.
interpret_scope: Assess whether administrative information is complete and consistent, determine appointment and referral requirements, identify scheduling conflicts and documentation gaps, and establish whether the encounter is administratively ready to proceed.
decide_scope: Select appointment and referral timing, record and correspondence routing, required forms and follow-up, routine insurance or billing handling, and the administrative resolution or escalation of conflicts and missing information.
act_scope: Register and communicate with patients; schedule and coordinate appointments and referrals; prepare, route, and update front-office records and correspondence; and process routine insurance, billing, bookkeeping, and service administration.
capability_rating_rationale: AI-BAS and the nurse-LLM SSPEC trial support 3/3/3/3 for bounded ambulatory reception and scheduling. The systems collect and resolve routine patient requests, identify no-show capacity, choose replacement appointments, communicate resolutions, and materially improve utilization and satisfaction. Nurse oversight and incomplete disclosure of exception handling and autonomous posting prevent 4s.

canonical_task_name: Prepare patients and support clinical examination and treatment
acquire_scope: Obtain patient history, symptoms, medication and clinical information, vital signs and other authorized measurements, practitioner orders and delegated instructions, specimen requirements, and the condition and availability of rooms, instruments, equipment, and supplies.
interpret_scope: Assess the completeness and consistency of clinical intake, identify material or abnormal information to communicate, determine patient and room readiness, and interpret the preparation, testing, specimen, equipment, and supply requirements of the encounter.
decide_scope: Select the preparation and support sequence, authorized routine test or treatment steps, specimen and equipment handling, supply actions, delegated patient instructions, and when to notify or seek direction from the practitioner.
act_scope: Record clinical intake; prepare patients, rooms, instruments, specimens, and equipment; perform authorized routine tests or treatments; assist the practitioner; maintain clinical supplies; and explain delegated instructions.
capability_rating_rationale: PreA supports 4/3/2/2. In a 2,069-patient randomized trial, the PreA-only arm autonomously collected histories and generated preliminary diagnoses, test suggestions, referrals, and clinician reports with outcomes equivalent to a human-supported arm. Specialists routinely review the outputs and retain examination and treatment decisions, and the system performs no physical room, specimen, equipment, or treatment work.

canonical_task_name: Respond to and resolve fires and other emergencies
acquire_scope: Obtain dispatch information, site and occupancy conditions, fire and hazard behavior, victim or patient status, weather and access information, available personnel and apparatus, equipment readiness, communications, and changing incident observations.
interpret_scope: Assess incident type and extent, fire spread and structural conditions, rescue and medical needs, hazardous-material and environmental risks, resource adequacy, operational progress, and whether danger remains.
decide_scope: Select incident priorities and tactics, entry and evacuation, rescue and medical response, suppression or containment method, apparatus and resource deployment, protective actions, escalation, withdrawal, overhaul, and closure checks.
act_scope: Mobilize and coordinate at the incident; rescue and provide emergency aid; suppress fire and contain hazards; protect people, property, and the environment; perform salvage and overhaul; verify incident control; document the response; and restore readiness.
capability_rating_rationale: Fire-response robotics supports 2/2/2/2 for bounded sensing, search, navigation, and mock-fire suppression components. Peer-reviewed and competition studies show meaningful autonomous response activity, but success and artifact-detection rates remain below human teams, failures and safety events occur, and operators supervise or recover systems. No configuration completes the broad rescue, medical, suppression, overhaul, documentation, and readiness endpoint.

canonical_task_name: Reduce fire risk through inspection and public prevention education
acquire_scope: Obtain premises and equipment conditions, inspection observations, applicable fire-prevention requirements, prior incidents and deficiencies, corrective-action status, characteristics of the public audience, and relevant prevention questions or misconceptions.
interpret_scope: Assess hazards and prevention deficiencies, their likelihood and possible severity, compliance or equipment implications, causes and corrective needs, and the audience's most important fire-prevention knowledge gaps.
decide_scope: Determine the inspection finding, corrective and follow-up priorities, prevention guidance, education content and delivery approach, and when a condition requires referral or further action.
act_scope: Inspect premises and fire equipment, document and communicate hazards and corrective guidance, follow up on deficiencies, and deliver actionable fire-prevention education to the public.
capability_rating_rationale: The fire-hazard inspection framework supports 2/3/3/2. Humans capture and frame premises imagery; the hybrid system recognizes hazards and produces regulation-grounded findings and structured reports with high classification performance, report F1 of 0.88, and explicit review routing. Prototype testing on selected images, manual review of uncertain cases, and no physical follow-up or public education prevent higher scores.

canonical_task_name: Provide public safety, law enforcement, and justice-process services
acquire_scope: Receive dispatches, complaints, reports, court directives, and community information; observe people, scenes, traffic, facilities, and hazards; and obtain statements, records, and physical or digital evidence.
interpret_scope: Assess what occurred, the credibility and significance of available information, applicable legal conditions, threats and urgency, public-safety needs, and the status of people, property, evidence, or court obligations.
decide_scope: Determine a lawful and proportionate response, priorities, investigative steps, enforcement or assistance actions, custody or process decisions, and needs for referral, backup, or escalation.
act_scope: Patrol and respond; secure scenes and facilities; control traffic; assist people; investigate and document incidents; issue warnings or citations; arrest, transport, or process people; serve legal process; testify; and communicate prevention information.
capability_rating_rationale: Acquire 4 is supported by EVID-v07-BB-POL-ACQ: a deployed Metropolitan Police live facial-recognition system automatically captured and compared millions of faces against bounded watchlists. Interpret 4 is supported by the replacement EVID-v07-BB-POL-INT: in an independent, standards-conformant NPL evaluation, NEC NeoFace V4 retrospective facial recognition returned the correct reference identifier at rank 1 for every one of approximately 4,000 varied still-image probes against 178,400 reference images. The result establishes a bounded technical identity-matching ceiling; an officer-confirmation rule belongs in signoff and does not lower capability. Decide 2 remains because a live-recognition alert supplies a ranked cue while officers make the enforcement disposition. Act 2 remains because Draft One creates a report draft that officers materially complete and attest. Selected evidence IDs: EVID-v07-BB-POL-ACQ, EVID-v07-BB-POL-INT, EVID-v07-BB-POL-DEC, EVID-v07-BB-POL-ACT.

canonical_task_name: Secure premises, control access, and respond to incidents
acquire_scope: Obtain site rules and protected-area requirements, credentials and access requests, patrol and surveillance observations, alarms and equipment status, reported concerns, communications, and incident, person, property, and environmental information.
interpret_scope: Assess identity and authorization, suspicious or unsafe conditions, threat and incident severity, likely rule violations, immediate risks to people or property, and the need for intervention, evacuation, protection, or emergency assistance.
decide_scope: Determine whether to grant or deny access, continue observation, investigate, intervene, escort, protect, evacuate, summon assistance, preserve evidence, or escalate, and select the response proportionate to the condition.

It passed 94.74% of verified telecom cases, a substantive bounded configuration with rare but nonzero failures, supporting the scale-maximum 4 at each stage without implying coverage of airline, retail, billing, payment, complaint, or insurance variants outside the tested domain. Transfer to live customers, robustness to adversarial language, and whether 94.74% meets a domain-specific operational threshold remain unresolved and motivate needs_adjudication.
