capability_rating_rationale: EVID-v07-OPS-013 through EVID-v07-OPS-016 use DeepSeek V3.2 in the KDD 2026 Agent-Diff no-documentation configuration. Those results demonstrate substantial performance at every stage, but the 24% whole-task failure rate means a human must materially check, correct, or complete ordinary cases, so 3 is not supported and each stage is 2. Physical reception, calls, mail, equipment, supplies, cash, payroll, travel, and live-office conditions were not tested. Selected stage evidence IDs: EVID-v07-OPS-013, EVID-v07-OPS-014, EVID-v07-OPS-015, EVID-v07-OPS-016.

interpret_scope: Identify plants, pests, weeds, and disease; assess soil and growing conditions, plant health, maturity, water and nutrient status, crop progress, and equipment and facility readiness; classify or grade product quality; and analyze labor, post-harvest, storage, packing, delivery, and customer-suitability needs.
decide_scope: Choose the timing, method, sequence, inputs, equipment, and labor for site preparation, planting, cultivation, irrigation, fertilization, crop protection, pruning, harvest, sorting, treatment, storage, packing, movement, sale, delivery, maintenance, and replenishment, and select bounded product-selection or care guidance.
act_scope: Prepare soil and growing areas; plant, transplant, cultivate, irrigate, fertilize, prune, protect, and harvest crops or plants; sort, treat, store, pack, load, move, sell, or deliver products; operate and maintain supporting equipment and facilities; direct seasonal work; order production supplies; and update records and inventory, report crop progress, and provide customer guidance.
capability_rating_rationale: Stagewise frontier 4/4/4/3. Selected evidence: EVID-v07-FARM-TOMATO-ACQ, EVID-v07-FARM-TOMATO-INT, EVID-v07-FARM-TOMATO-DEC, EVID-v07-FARM-TOMATO-ACT. Each maximum is conditional on the bounded operating configuration and exclusions stated in its evidence row; the vector does not claim one interoperable end-to-end system or broad coverage of every activity in the canonical task.

canonical_task_name: Fell, process, and grade timber with logging equipment
acquire_scope: Obtain the harvest plan and timber specifications, tree locations and characteristics, terrain and access conditions, required log dimensions and grades, equipment and cutting-head status, hazards, and operator-readiness information.
interpret_scope: Assess tree and log size, form, defects, grade, and cutting requirements, machine positioning and reach, terrain and safety risks, equipment performance, and whether processed logs meet specified handling and shipment requirements.
decide_scope: Select trees and operating sequence, machine position and setup, felling and processing cuts, log length and grade, measurement response, operator-level maintenance, and when conditions require stopping or escalation.
act_scope: Position and operate mechanized logging equipment to fell, shear, delimb, and cut trees; measure and grade resulting logs; maintain operator readiness; and record the completed processing work.
capability_rating_rationale: SAHA demonstrates useful autonomous navigation, positioning, gripping, and cutting in real forest trials, but humans supply the target tree and confirm or trigger each cut, interventions recur, and the source does not demonstrate delimbing, cut-to-length processing, or grading. The supported vector is 2/2/1/2.

canonical_task_name: Move, stage, and load timber with logging equipment
acquire_scope: Obtain processed-timber location, quantity and condition, terrain and ground capacity, road, landing, and access status, movement and loading requirements, equipment and attachment condition, shift information, and operating hazards.
interpret_scope: Assess feasible movement routes, ground and landing conditions, load balance and capacity, bunching, skidding, forwarding, and loading requirements, access obstacles, equipment readiness, and safety risks.
decide_scope: Select equipment, route, operating sequence, bunching and lifting method, skidding or forwarding approach, load and stack arrangement, access clearing or maintenance, and operator-level maintenance response.
act_scope: Operate skidders, forwarders, loaders, tractors, and related equipment to bunch, drag, transport, load, unload, and stack timber; clear or maintain access and landing areas; maintain operator readiness; and complete shift records.
capability_rating_rationale: The ICRA 2024 autonomous log-loader is direct, peer-reviewed evidence for a substantive bounded loading cycle. Its integrated perception, grasp planning, motion planning, and crane control support 3/3/3/3; 87% maneuver success, manually repositioned missed logs, and failure recovery prevent 4s.

Interpret is 3 rather than 4 because overall accuracy is about 90%, localization performance varies materially by defect class, and routine human verification remains necessary.

occupation_name: Electrical and Electronics Installers and Repairers, Transportation Equipment

acquire_scope: Obtain work orders and production needs, operator reports, machinery state and history, manuals and specifications, inspection and test readings, control or program information, part and material availability, prior maintenance records, and applicable safety conditions.

canonical_task_name: Receive, store, and replenish inventory
acquire_scope: Obtain shipments, item and location information, counts, planograms, prices, stock requests, condition observations, inventory records, and reorder or disposition requirements.
interpret_scope: Match items to records and locations; identify shortages, overages, damage, misplacement, pricing or display discrepancies, unsafe conditions, and replenishment or reorder needs.
decide_scope: Determine acceptance, storage, organization, replenishment, pricing, display, reorder, return, or disposal actions and their sequence.
act_scope: Unload, count, inspect, mark, price, store, organize, clean, replenish, display, record, reorder, return, or dispose of inventory so it remains accurate, safe, accessible, and available.
capability_rating_rationale: EVID-v07-STOCK1-PIXELS-ACQ, EVID-v07-STOCK1-PIXELS-INT, EVID-v07-STOCK1-PIXELS-DEC, and EVID-v07-STOCK1-PIXELS-ACT support 4/4/4/4 for the bounded unit of autonomously stocking one supported can or small box from a nearby cart to a mapped shelf. The integrated Stretch 3 configuration achieved 98.3% success across 724 full pick-and-place events. Across 70 multi-item tasks it achieved greater than 87% full-task success, with eight partial failures and one complete failure requiring human intervention. The representative per-item result and only one intervention in 70 multi-item runs establish acceptable bounded performance without a routine pre-effect human gate under protocol section 1.5; they do not establish unattended shift coverage. interpret_scope: Translate the order or requisition into the required items and quantities; verify item identity, availability, condition, and match to the request; calculate checkout totals when applicable; and identify shortages, discrepancies, handling needs, and completion status.
decide_scope: Choose the stock locations, picking and handling sequence, equipment, packing method, issue or delivery route, and response to shortages or discrepancies needed to complete the specified order accurately.
act_scope: Move the assembled order with appropriate handling equipment; pack, itemize, and complete checkout when tied to the order; issue, distribute, or deliver it to the customer, coworker, or vehicle; and complete receipts and outgoing-order records.
